user_signal.goal_or_constraint: The system must stop making the user repeatedly rediscover the same abstract failure class. Systemic repair should start from the global outline, reuse historical lessons and validated mechanisms, repair the reusable class, and only then return to the concrete instance.
user_signal.counterexample: The control plane already documented parent-system reframing, proactive learning, failure-class distillation and second-order review, yet later Financial and Universal incidents still required user correction before analogous omissions were recognized. The prior method could record a failure_classes list without mechanically proving that historical same-class repairs were searched or that recurrence forced a higher abstraction level.
user_signal.proposed_mechanism: Use an explicit abstraction ladder: INSTANCE -> FAILURE_CLASS -> OWNER_OR_COMPONENT_MECHANISM -> SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE -> META_METHOD. Search prior same-class incidents before systemic repair; when a class recurs after an accepted fix, require a strictly higher abstraction level, then descend to validate both class-level prevention and the concrete instance fix.

falsification_checks: A current-schema systemic run that omits failure_history must fail.
A failure_history search that omits one classified failure class must fail.
A known/recurrent class with no prior incident or repair ref must fail.
A RECURRED_AFTER_FIX run that stays at the prior abstraction level must fail.
A repair that previously reached META_METHOD and recurs must require explicit MAX_LEVEL_REDESIGN rather than pretending there is another higher named level.
A valid escalated repair must still record both class_level_prevention and instance_fix; high-level redesign alone cannot close the concrete defect.
The parent-system impact map must precede detailed root-cause drilling in the canonical maintenance loop and reference simulation.
The concrete class/instance repair must occur before validation rather than being recorded after validation as review theater.
The runtime's executable recurrence statuses, abstraction ladder and escalation decisions must fail closed if they drift from SYSTEM_MAINTENANCE_POLICY.json.
The full synthetic fault suite must execute a same-or-lower-level recurrence case and reject it.
Tightening a status-cache semantic key must not silently break an established downstream compatibility key.
Legacy v1.0-v1.2 meta-maintenance records must remain readable as historical evidence rather than being rewritten or treated as current-schema executions.

failure_history.escalation_reason: V59 already repaired the shared parent self-maintenance/evolution architecture and explicitly named symptom-first repair plus user-reminder dependence. V60 then exposed another operator-reminder variant, and the Financial live trajectory exposed another negative-space/output-contract omission. The recurring family therefore cannot be closed by another owner-local guard or another architecture diagram; the maintenance method itself must mechanically require historical class recall and abstraction escalation.
failure_history.class_level_prevention: SYSTEM_MAINTENANCE_POLICY v1.8 now owns a failure-abstraction escalation contract. Meta-maintenance schema v1.3 requires every current systemic run to search all classified failure classes, bind prior incidents for known/recurrent classes, escalate recurrence after an accepted fix above the prior repair level, and record both class-level prevention and the concrete instance fix. The canonical loop builds the parent-system impact outline before deep root-cause drilling and returns from the higher-level repair to class+instance work before validation. runtime/system_audit.py now also injects a same-level recurrence fault so the rule is exercised rather than only declared.
failure_history.instance_fix: The current Financial 3-to-2 delivery incident remains repaired in the Financial owner by canonical TaskContract/output parity. In Universal, the first v61 CI exposed stale self-maintenance trajectory/order and version-pin consumers; a later closure CI exposed a status-cache compatibility-key regression. Those consumers were repaired without weakening the new invariant, and the missing recurrence fault-injection consumer was added to the executable system-audit suite.

sources.observation: Google SRE recommends digging deeper when incidents mirror previous incidents, questioning whether action items were wrong, refactoring is overdue, or Band-Aids are being applied; it also recommends bringing similar incidents together.
sources.rationale: Directly supports treating recurrence as evidence that the previous repair level may be insufficient rather than as another isolated ticket.

sources.observation: Standardized incident classification supports trend analysis that targets systemic root-cause types rather than only individual outages.
sources.rationale: Supports durable failure-class categorization and historical matching as part of maintenance diagnosis.

sources.observation: Double-loop learning distinguishes correcting an error within existing objectives from challenging the underlying policies or objectives when those assumptions themselves permit recurrence.
sources.rationale: The useful primitive is escalation of the challenged abstraction when prior corrective assumptions fail; Universal does not adopt the organizational framework as a new authority or vocabulary dependency.

V60 later documented another operator-reminder failure where signal emission had been treated as repair closure.
Before schema 1.3, runtime/meta_maintenance.py required a non-empty failure_classes list but had no required historical match, recurrence status, prior repair level or abstraction escalation field.
runtime/decision_memory.py currently makes rejected alternatives searchable but does not provide an authoritative automatic incident database for failure classes.

The current change adds no new permanent Agent, registry or business owner and does not mutate any BUSINESS task state.

The first future real systemic incident under v1.3 is still needed to demonstrate that the method reduces user-reminder dependence in live operation.

architecture_payoff.current_failure_cost: Repeated user correction, duplicated diagnosis effort, re-learning previously documented lessons, local patches that do not eliminate the failure family, and loss of trust in claimed self-evolution.
architecture_payoff.change_cost: One compatible maintenance-policy version bump, one meta-harness schema increment, one existing reference simulation alignment, one existing fault-suite extension, bounded regression additions, one v61 maintenance record and cache/checkpoint reconciliation.
architecture_payoff.expected_payoff: Known failure families become mandatory diagnostic inputs. Recurrence after a prior accepted fix mechanically forces a higher abstraction challenge, detailed diagnosis is constrained by a parent-system impact outline, and an executable synthetic recurrence fault prevents the policy from silently losing its enforcement path.
architecture_payoff.deletion_or_simplification_result: Reuse the existing SYSTEM_MAINTENANCE_POLICY, meta harness, self-maintenance trajectory simulator and system-audit fault framework; do not create a separate reflection system, failure registry or duplicated startup doctrine. Runtime mirrors of the escalation vocabulary are fail-closed against the canonical policy. Stale exact-version assertions were removed where version identity was not the behavior under test, while established status-cache keys were retained for downstream compatibility and tightened semantics were added alongside them.

instruction_surface.reason: This defect occurs after repository maintenance authority is already loaded. Expanding account/startup instructions would duplicate the policy and would not mechanically enforce parent-system outline ordering, historical recall, recurrence escalation, consumer propagation or fault injection.

propagation.mechanism: All current BUSINESS owners continue inheriting the existing operational_hygiene/evolution parent method; the shared maintenance semantics now include parent-outline-before-deep-diagnosis, history-before-repair, recurrence escalation, class+instance return before validation, and recurrence fault injection at the Universal verification layer. No owner business rule, state, task lease or article workflow is copied into Universal.

The old ordering that allowed detailed root-cause drilling before the full-system impact outline is superseded.

second_order_findings: The first genuine CI failure proved the initial v61 implementation itself had consumer-incomplete propagation; the repair used that evidence to expand the impact map rather than treating failing tests as obstacles to green status.

The later closure CI proved the same failure class still existed at another consumer boundary. The repair therefore preserved compatibility and widened executable fault coverage instead of editing only the failing assertion.

The old self-maintenance regression preserved a stronger outline-first invariant than the first v61 policy edit. The final order keeps BUILD_FULL_SYSTEM_IMPACT_MAP before detailed DIAGNOSE_ROOT_CAUSE instead of merely updating the test to match newer code.
A required failure_history object does not prove semantic completeness of the historical search; classification and analogue matching remain model/evidence judgments.

Free-form failure-class names can fragment semantically identical incidents under different labels. If live v1.3 use still misses obvious analogues, the next META_METHOD repair should evaluate normalized concept keys or indexed semantic retrieval rather than adding more policy prose.

Forcing escalation on every new instance of a known class would overreact; strict higher-level escalation is reserved for RECURRED_AFTER_FIX or CROSS_OWNER_RECURRENT, while KNOWN_CLASS_NEW_INSTANCE requires prior refs but may reuse a still-valid mechanism.
Escalation is not permission to abandon the triggering defect. Both class_level_prevention and instance_fix remain mandatory before validation so architectural thinking cannot become review theater.
No claim is made that this structural harness independently verifies diagnosis quality or guarantees that future users will never need to correct the system.
